architecturalPlan.scaleRationale: A compact single-storey 16 m by 11 m family envelope is sized to reserve four-bedroom capacity while retaining a generous shared living edge, pool terrace and private garden rather than deriving area from an assumed budget.
architecturalPlan.arrivalAndCirculation: The public arrival path reaches a recessed front portal at slab top 0.20 m, with living, dining and garden doors opening directly to the rear terrace at the same datum; private bedroom accommodation and service planning are reserved within the envelope, while all constructed exterior circulation remains ground-level.
architecturalPlan.volumeHierarchy: The 3.40 m primary residence is a single calm limestone datum capped by a 0.24 m flat roof at 3.72 m, with lower 3.20 m covered dining and entry canopies acting as subordinate outdoor volumes.
architecturalPlan.relationshipsAndViews: A central arrival faces the solid street elevation, while broad rear glazing connects the family living zone to a 16 m terrace, covered outdoor dining, rectangular pool and an intentionally unbuilt private-garden reserve beyond.
architecturalPlan.roofFacadeAndMaterials: Limestone enclosure walls, bronze-framed glazing and timber-toned shaded thresholds establish a contemporary, warm palette, with deep roof edges and independent canopy planes giving the long glazed garden facade shade and visual depth.
